fields.summary_ko.0: Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL) declined 17% monthly and over 30% from its 52-week high, but the slowdown in Google Search growth is attributed to a strong year-over-year comparison base.
fields.summary_ko.1: Google Cloud is growing at a 103% year-over-year rate in Q3 revenue, with AI adoption and increased cloud infrastructure demand expected to be key growth drivers.
